segments.2CH.35.18-19: No Passover like this had been kept since Samuel
segments.2CH.35.20-21: Neco warns Josiah to stop opposing God
segments.2CH.35.22-22: Josiah does not listen and goes to fight Neco
segments.2CH.35.23-24: Archers wound Josiah, and he dies in Jerusalem
segments.2CH.36.1-2: The people make Jehoahaz king after Josiah
segments.2CH.36.3-4: Neco removes Jehoahaz and makes Jehoiakim king
segments.2CH.36.11-12: Zedekiah does not humble himself before Jeremiah
segments.2CH.36.13-14: Zedekiah rebels and the leaders defile the temple
segments.2CH.36.15-16: God sends messengers, but the people mock the prophets
segments.2CH.36.17-17: God brings the king of the Chaldeans against Judah
segments.2CH.36.18-19: The Chaldeans take the treasures and burn the temple
segments.2CH.36.20-21: Survivors go to Babylon and the land rests seventy years
